corridor.name: University Corridor
corridor.description: A long, echoing corridor lined with notice boards. Professor Riddle patrols here before his lecture.
corridor.image_prompt: university corridor, old academic building, notice boards, moody lighting

classroom.name: Professor's Classroom
classroom.description: A strict and orderly classroom. The door is locked — only those who have passed the professor's test may enter.
classroom.image_prompt: gothic university classroom, chalkboard, old desks, fantasy style

textbook.name: Advanced Textbook on Magic
textbook.description: A heavy tome required by Professor Riddle. He will only accept students who bring it.
textbook.image_prompt: advanced magic textbook, leather bound, fantasy style

hero.name: Alden the Student
hero.description: A determined student trying to pass his project and earn the professor's approval.
hero.image_prompt: young university student, backpack, fantasy setting

professor.name: Professor Riddle
professor.description: A notoriously difficult professor known for his cryptic demands and impossible standards.
professor.image_prompt: elderly wizard professor, glasses, stern expression, academic robes

dialogues.before_talk: Riddle: You dare approach me empty-handed? Bring me the Advanced Textbook — then we can talk.
dialogues.after_talk: Riddle: Still looking for that textbook? Check the corridor shelves!
dialogues.after_satisfied: Riddle: Hmm... acceptable. You may proceed to the classroom.
dialogues.hostile: Riddle: Outrageous! Security! Remove this student at once!
